payment_plan.quote: will allow for at least 30 days past the payment due date before pursuing collections

notes: Policy states that whenever possible, eligibility for financial assistance will be determined before or at the time of admission.
Policy mentions that if an insured patient is not eligible for assistance, reasonable payment plan options will be offered.
Policy references compliance with PPACA, Internal Revenue Code Section 501(r), and Colorado Senate Bill 14-50.
Copayments for insured patients cannot be lower than the 0-250% copay amounts.
Copayments for uninsured patients cannot be lower than the 0-250% insured copay amounts.
Patient's copayments cannot be lower than the 0-150% copay amounts (for Kansas).

dropped.claim: A patient with (co_resident OR in_service_area OR medically_necessary OR fpl_pct <= 250) gets 100% off
dropped.quote: The legislation requires hospitals to provide financial assistance to patients in emergent situations and whose incomes are less than 250 percent of the current year’s federal poverty level.
dropped.why: Policy restricts financial assistance to Colorado residents in emergent situations with income ≤250% FPL, not any of the four conditions.
